implementation_choices.TCN: two causal Conv1d layers per residual block, left zero padding; 1x1 residual projection where dimensions differ
implementation_choices.Transformer: PyTorch default post-norm encoder with ReLU; positional parameters initialized N(0,0.02)
implementation_choices.LSTM_AE: encoder final hidden vector repeated 20 steps; decoder initial hidden and cell are zero
implementation_choices.threshold: exact maximum DEVELOPMENT VALIDATION F1 over distinct observed scores; lowest threshold on ties
implementation_choices.resources: one seed at a time, two CPU threads and 45% GPU allocation cap
